sql: SELECT toYear(fs.DateKey) AS Year, sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales, sum(fs.SalesQuantity) AS TotalQuantity, sum(fs.SalesAmount - fs.TotalCost) AS GrossProfit, sum(fs.ReturnAmount) AS TotalReturns, sum(fs.DiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscounts FROM retail.FactSales AS fs INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey WHERE pc.ProductCategoryName = 'Cameras and camcorders' GROUP BY Year ORDER BY Year
